main_text.p: Et reverà, nusquam alibi Canonicis in Epistolis, eadem omninò forma. Petrus & Johannes, ad morem Hebræorum, precantur pacem. Tertullianus, adversf. Marcion L.v. de primâ ad Corinth. Nam & hodie Judæi in pacis nomine appellant, & retrò in scripturis sic salutabant. Paulus vero gratiam, τοῦτ' ἐςι[?], τὴν ἄφεσιν τῶν ἁμαρ-τιῶν, καὶ τὴν καθαρσιν. In omnibus ad unam Epistolis, signaculi loco, ἡ χάρις μεθ' ὑμῶν, vel μεθὰ πάντων ὑμῶν.

V. Instat doctissimus Camero, σημεῖον illud διακριτικὸν Paulinarum, consistere in eo, quod propriâ manu salutationes scribat. Et hoc demùm velle pro signo haberi, in omnibus suis Epistolis. Id autem non factum in hac ipsâ, adeoque nec Pauli esse Epistolam. Atqui 1. supponit gratis, signi omnem hanc fuisse rationem, quod salutationes suâ ipsius manu scriberet. Expen-denti locum illum ad Thessalonicenses, de Pauli signaculo occurrunt duo; primò ratione formæ ipsâ Pauli Apostoli manu scribi solitum; deinde ratione materiæ constitisse his verbis, sic, inquit, scribo,

page.notes: Greek "τοῦτ' ἐςι" in the gratiam passage is hard to read and may be misprinted or misread; the catchword "ἡχάρις" is uncertain in its accents and spacing. The left edge shows a dark smudge and the top right has scan speckle; neither is printed text. Printed text is set in mixed roman and italic; Greek is in Greek letters as printed.
